content:
morgan: Planning Dedicated rollout for customer AstraWell tonight 23:00 PT. Requesting final approvals and any blockers. Target: pin runtime to v2.1.6-prod, model bundle rwl-3.2. Deploy window 23:00-00:30 PT. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
deploy-bot: Rollout job created: job_id=rb-2026-03-23-3412345678. Canary slices: 5% for 10m, 25% for 15m, then full. Version pin: runtime=v2.1.6-prod, model=rwl-3.2, quant_profile=q4_256. See /ops/rollouts/rb-2026-03-23.
maya: Customer success confirmed cutover notification sent to AstraWell PM (June Park). They accept 23:00 PT and will pause non-critical traffic for 30m post-cutover.
sahil: From release lead: checklist
- infra preflight ✅ (nate)
- perf baselines collected ✅ (olivia)
- KMS key confirmed ✅ (jordan)
- rollback plan ready ✅
If canary metrics meet thresholds I'll give greenlight.
olivia: Perf notes: expected p50 token latency ~180-200ms at 5% slice. Benchmarked under similar load. Watch p95, GPU mem, and KV cache hit ratio. I'll be watching dashboards.
jordan: Security/KMS: using key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01. No rotations scheduled. Key access audited; rotation window clear. Recommend disabling automated rotation until cutover completes (:lock:).
nate: Infra: reserved slice on Dedicated pool ada-ded-11. Autoscaler disabled for slice during rollout. Burst capacity available if latency degrades.
sahil: Approval checklist for go/no-go:
- p95 latency delta < +25% vs baseline
- 5xx error rate < 0.5%
- Token cost delta < +15%
If any breach -> immediate rollback to runtime v2.1.5 and model rwl-3.1.
morgan: Rollback and emergency commands (kept minimal):
```
# rollback to previous runtime
deployctl promote --job rb-rollback-3412345678 --runtime v2.1.5 --model rwl-3.1 --force
```
And fallback policy: route to secondary region for AstraWell if Dedicated pool has issues.
deploy-bot: Canary started: slice=5% id=rb-2026-03-23-3412345678-stage1. Monitoring hooks active (latency, errors, cost). Will report after 10m.
olivia: Observing first 2m: p50 ~185ms, p95 ~310ms (baseline 280ms), errors 0.12%. KV cache hit 82%. So far within thresholds. Continuing to monitor.
sahil: I'm +1 provisionally; hold for canary completion and deploy-bot health summary. Ready to approve full ramp if metrics hold for next 8m.
jordan: Confirmed audit logging streaming to customer audit endpoint during rollout. No elevated IAM events.
deploy-bot: Canary stage complete: 5% healthy -> metrics okay. Advancing to 25% slice. stage_id=rb-2026-03-23-3412345678-stage2.
morgan: Noted. Reminder: Post-cutover tickets: update release notes, notify billing for cost delta monitoring, and schedule 1h follow-up with AstraWell tomorrow.
maya: Will handle release notes and post-cutover comms. Adding follow-up calendar invite.
sahil: Final: greenlight to continue to 100% if stage2 stays within thresholds for 15m. I will post final approval.
deploy-bot: stage2 25% running. Alerts configured: latency_alert=p95>450ms; error_alert=5xx>0.5%; cost_alert=token_cost_increase>20%.
olivia: At 7m into 25%: p50=195ms, p95=340ms, 5xx=0.08%. No anomalous spikes. GPU util steady.
sahil: +1 final. Proceed to full rollout at end of stage2 window. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Rolling to 100% now. job_id=rb-2026-03-23-3412345678-final. Estimated completion in 10m.
nate: Keeping autoscaler locked until monitoring confirms stability. If any alert fires, I'll trigger deployctl rollback as instructed.
morgan: Thanks all. I'll update the ticket with final status once deploy-bot confirms completion and will attach rollback logs and the promote command used earlier for quick access.
deploy-bot: Rollout succeeded: job_id=rb-2026-03-23-3412345678. Final state=SUCCESS. Notes: runtime=v2.1.6-prod pinned, model=rwl-3.2, quant_profile=q4_256. No rollbacks triggered.
